basics.name: Storm Selvig
basics.label: Software Engineer & M.Sc. AI/IoT Student
basics.summary: I build practical systems with C, C++, Python, and web technologies. I am a software engineer and an M.Sc. student in Artificial Intelligence and the Internet of Things at the University of Agder. My work spans embedded test automation, offshore firmware and topside software, legacy modernization, and UiASub robotics. My AI experience includes a RAG system developed for UiA, multi-agent systems, and self-hosted models. I have also taken part in NM in AI and hackathons.
